explanation: Their babble, a jumble of words from several languages, is voiced by co-director Pierre Coffin. The film was animated in Paris by the French studio Mac Guff.

claims.text: The Minions first appeared in Despicable Me (2010).
The Minions do not appear in Megamind, Shrek or Madagascar.
The Minions' voices, a mix of words from several languages, were performed by the co-director Pierre Coffin.
Despicable Me was animated in Paris by the French studio Mac Guff, whose animation unit Illumination later bought.

writerNotes: Self-check 9.3. Lint: clean. Datasets: no pinned dataset covers film or TV facts, so every high-risk claim here needs checker evidence from the web. Rival test: Megamind is the trap: another animated comedy of the same year about a villain who turns good; Shrek and Madagascar are other studio hits. Volatility: evergreen; no time words; nothing depends on events after mid-2026. Regional: a worldwide release animated in France; the Minions need no language to be understood. Style: Oxford spelling, straight single quotes, plain hyphens, explanation of 27 words. Myths: claims screened against myths.json; no claim resembles a listed myth. Mystery and encore: not applicable to a practice item. Doubts: none beyond the high-risk claims flagged for external evidence.
